subject.pose: Static teaching presentation, no exact paleolocality or co-occurrence claim.

source_field_map.claim_scope: Original negative trace teaching form: shallow almond resting impression or a sediment-penetrating pointed-bottom conical cavity; no named tracemaker or copied excavated specimen.

distinctness.en: A compact almond-shaped resting impression with pointed ends.
distinctness.zh: 紧凑杏仁形停栖印两端尖收。

modeling_brief.en: Use original low-poly facets to emphasize: a compact almond-shaped resting impression with pointed ends. Keep secondary texture subordinate to the diagnostic geometry; choose one composition, not counted variants. Display convention: negative-impression; section cuts are illustrative, not an excavated specimen claim.
modeling_brief.zh: 采用原创低多边形几何突出：紧凑杏仁形停栖印两端尖收。次要纹理服从识别结构；只计一种构图，不靠变体增数。 表现方式：凹陷印迹；剖切是示意，不声称复制出土标本。

reference_policy.scope: Child-friendly static stylized-inspired environment prop; no strict scientific reconstruction.
reference_policy.minimum_reference: Use a reliable named museum/specimen/institution or primary reference supporting recognizable basic form; existing ledger entries are retrieval leads with inherited access notes, not a new verification by this planning task. Group-only overview cannot prove a genus-specific diagnostic feature. No mandatory species/specimen matching beyond the basic form actually claimed.
reference_policy.reference_rights: Consulting facts does not require licensing a copied asset. References are consulted-only, with source URLs and actual access status retained. No reference media/scan/mesh is incorporated. If incorporating third-party media, record actual rights/license/permission first; the string consulted-only is not a third-party license grant. Prefer original geometry/maps and avoid this dependency.
reference_policy.continue_rule: Once reliable basic form and original/authorized inputs are established, proceed after the parent CI/claim gate. Do not repeatedly research or repair because color, restored soft tissue, pose, dimensions, plate/feather counts or fine reconstruction are uncertain. Label artistic choices.
reference_policy.block_only: A real basic identity contradiction, no reliable support for the named form actually claimed, unlicensed incorporated material, visibly broken proportion/connection at intended view, or failed required technical/delivery checks remains actionable. Narrow unsupported claims to the descriptive inspired-by fallback; do not invent sources or a factual PASS.
reference_policy.repair_bound: One consolidated independent QA and at most one planned cosmetic repair as the inherited practical profile specifies; persistent required defects return to parent for scope/hold decision rather than an open-ended reconstruction campaign.

scale.kind: nominal art-direction choice, not a newly measured fossil dimension; display scaling separately labeled

artistic_choices: Nominal size, palette and interpretive exposure/section/layout are artistic choices, not measured site data.
One original inventory ID counts once; color, damage, density and display revisions are not new entries.

original_criteria.description: Exact standalone GLB validates/reimports; finite geometry, units/origin and measured separate budgets; warnings dispositioned.

Neutral-gray top/oblique views show actual almond-shaped negative resting relief or pointed-bottom conical penetration; optional diagnostic section clarifies depth. Preserve negative-impression; slab outline alone is not identification.

原negative-impression：杏仁形浅凹有明确两端收尖、内部凹度与边缘过渡，不是涂黑叶形或完整贝壳压入。不指定双壳物种/制造者，灰色顶斜视检查内部形态，不以外底板识别。 Preserve original reference scope, uncertainty and representation label. No extra microscopic or precise life-reconstruction obligations.

Editable Blend, standalone GLB, deterministic generator/config and dependency hashes, bilingual metadata/scope/provenance/attribution, original small maps if used, transparent cover, eight fixed views and actual-GLB runtime evidence.
Exact GLB parsed by pinned target loader; record bounds/material/texture/errors.
Declared functional graphics runtime; identify software/hardware honestly, no unsupported physical-device performance claim.
Neutral multiple-copy teaching-prop benchmark with actual instance/work counts; no actual museum integration or cross-era habitat claim.

scientific_limits.en: Trace-morphology teaching concept showing one shallow almond-shaped negative resting impression with pointed ends in an interpretive sediment crop. Not a shell, body fossil, named tracemaker or copied excavated specimen. Nominal 20 cm crop span, relief and palette are artistic choices; the crop is not an inferred organism size.
scientific_limits.zh: 遗迹形态教学概念：示意沉积裁片内的一处浅杏仁状负型停栖凹印，两端尖收。不是贝壳、实体化石、指定造迹者或出土标本复制；名义20厘米裁片跨度、凹凸及配色属美术选择，裁片大小不代表生物体尺寸。

scientific_qualifications.value: The geological primary source describes oval/almond outlines and common positive hyporelief preservation, while the frozen brief explicitly calls for a negative-impression artistic teaching concept. This asset has a true shallow almond depression with pointed ends and continuous surface transition; it is not represented as a copied positive fossil cast.

Negative relief is the original educational convention, not a claim that all Lockeia fossils have negative relief. No precise species, producer, excavated specimen or certain resting behavior is identified.
Lockeia discussion and morphology paragraphs independently read, including positive hyporelief and preservation variability.
